# Reference

Every trigger, condition and action you can use in `automations.yaml`, with all fields and an example.
See [the automation file format](../guide/automations.md) for how they fit together, and
[placeholders](placeholders.md) for the `{{ ... }}` values you can use in text fields.

Editors that support JSON Schema (for example VS Code with the YAML extension) can use
[`automations.schema.json`](automations.schema.json) for autocomplete and validation.

## Triggers

A trigger starts an automation. An automation runs when **any** of its triggers fires.

### Computer & sign-in

| Type | What it does | Available in |
|---|---|---|
| [`boot`](triggers/boot.md) | Fires once each time the computer starts, before anyone signs in. | machine automations |
| [`logon`](triggers/logon.md) | Fires when a user signs in to Windows. The user who signed in is available to conditions and to actions as {{ user }}. | personal and machine automations |
| [`logoff`](triggers/logoff.md) | Fires when a user signs out. | personal and machine automations |
| [`lock`](triggers/lock.md) | Fires when a user locks the computer (Win+L, or automatically after inactivity). | personal and machine automations |
| [`unlock`](triggers/unlock.md) | Fires when a user unlocks the computer. | personal and machine automations |

### Apps

| Type | What it does | Available in |
|---|---|---|
| [`app_started`](triggers/app_started.md) | Fires when an app starts. | personal and machine automations |
| [`app_closed`](triggers/app_closed.md) | Fires when an app exits. | personal and machine automations |
| [`app_focused`](triggers/app_focused.md) | Fires when a window of the app becomes the active (foreground) window. | personal automations |
| [`app_unfocused`](triggers/app_unfocused.md) | Fires when the app stops being the active window, because another app was focused or the app was closed or minimized. | personal automations |

## Conditions

Conditions are checked after a trigger fires. **All** of them must be true for the actions to run.

### Logic

| Type | What it does | Available in |
|---|---|---|
| [`and`](conditions/and.md) | True when every nested condition is true. (The top-level condition list already works like this; use `and` inside `or`/`not`.) | personal and machine automations |
| [`or`](conditions/or.md) | True when at least one nested condition is true. | personal and machine automations |
| [`not`](conditions/not.md) | True when none of the nested conditions is true. | personal and machine automations |

### Context

| Type | What it does | Available in |
|---|---|---|
| [`user`](conditions/user.md) | True when the user involved is one of the listed users. In machine automations this is the user from the event (who signed in or started the app); in personal automations it is you. | personal and machine automations |
| [`time`](conditions/time.md) | True during a time window and/or on certain weekdays. Windows that cross midnight (after 22:00, before 06:00) are supported. | personal and machine automations |
| [`profile_active`](conditions/profile_active.md) | True when the profile is currently applied (or, with active: false, when it is not). | personal and machine automations |

### Device

| Type | What it does | Available in |
|---|---|---|
| [`power_source`](conditions/power_source.md) | True when the computer runs on the given power source. | personal and machine automations |
| [`battery`](conditions/battery.md) | True when the battery charge is within the given range. | personal and machine automations |
| [`wifi`](conditions/wifi.md) | True when connected to one of the Wi-Fi networks (or, with connected: false, when connected to none of them). | personal and machine automations |
| [`monitor_count`](conditions/monitor_count.md) | True when the number of connected monitors is within the range. Handy for docked/undocked laptops. | personal automations |

### Apps

| Type | What it does | Available in |
|---|---|---|
| [`app_running`](conditions/app_running.md) | True when one of the apps is running (or, with running: false, when none is). | personal and machine automations |
| [`app_focused`](conditions/app_focused.md) | True when one of the apps currently has the active window. | personal automations |
| [`fullscreen`](conditions/fullscreen.md) | True when a full-screen app, game or presentation is in the foreground. | personal automations |

## Actions

Actions run in order. Actions marked *revertible* can be used in profiles and are undone when the profile is reverted.

### Flow

| Type | What it does | Revertible | Runs as |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`profile.apply`](actions/profile.apply.md) | Applies a profile. The settings it changes are remembered and restored when the profile is reverted, automatically or with profile.revert. | no | the signed-in user |
| [`profile.revert`](actions/profile.revert.md) | Undoes an active profile, restoring the settings it changed. Does nothing if the profile is not active. | no | the signed-in user |
| [`delay`](actions/delay.md) | Waits before running the next action. | no | the signed-in user |

### Personalization

| Type | What it does | Revertible | Runs as |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`theme.mode`](actions/theme.mode.md) | Switches Windows and/or apps between light and dark mode. | yes | the signed-in user |
| [`theme.transparency`](actions/theme.transparency.md) | Turns transparency effects on or off. | yes | the signed-in user |
| [`wallpaper.set`](actions/wallpaper.set.md) | Sets the desktop background image. | yes | the signed-in user |
| [`taskbar.autohide`](actions/taskbar.autohide.md) | Turns taskbar auto-hide on or off. | yes | the signed-in user |

### Display

| Type | What it does | Revertible | Runs as |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`display.brightness`](actions/display.brightness.md) | Sets screen brightness. Works for laptop screens and for external monitors that support DDC/CI. | yes | the signed-in user |
| [`display.resolution`](actions/display.resolution.md) | Changes a monitor's resolution and/or refresh rate. | yes | the signed-in user |

### Power

| Type | What it does | Revertible | Runs as |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`power.plan`](actions/power.plan.md) | Activates a power plan. | yes | the signed-in user |
| [`power.screen_timeout`](actions/power.screen_timeout.md) | Sets how long before the screen turns off when idle, on the active power plan. | yes | the signed-in user |
| [`power.sleep_timeout`](actions/power.sleep_timeout.md) | Sets how long before the computer sleeps when idle, on the active power plan. | yes | the signed-in user |

### Audio

| Type | What it does | Revertible | Runs as |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`audio.volume`](actions/audio.volume.md) | Sets the master volume of an output device. | yes | the signed-in user |
| [`audio.mute`](actions/audio.mute.md) | Mutes, unmutes or toggles an output device. | yes | the signed-in user |
| [`audio.default_device`](actions/audio.default_device.md) | Makes a device the default speaker/headphones or microphone. | yes | the signed-in user |

### Network & devices

| Type | What it does | Revertible | Runs as |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`radio.set`](actions/radio.set.md) | Turns a wireless radio on, off, or toggles it. | yes | the signed-in user |
| [`mouse.speed`](actions/mouse.speed.md) | Sets the mouse pointer speed. | yes | the signed-in user |

### Apps & scripts

| Type | What it does | Revertible | Runs as |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`app.launch`](actions/app.launch.md) | Starts a program or opens a file. | no | the signed-in user |
| [`app.close`](actions/app.close.md) | Asks an app to close, like clicking its X button. With force: true it is ended if it does not close in time. | no | the signed-in user |
| [`command.run`](actions/command.run.md) | Runs a PowerShell script or a command line. | no | depends on the fields (see below) |
| [`notify`](actions/notify.md) | Shows a Windows notification. | no | the signed-in user |
| [`open`](actions/open.md) | Opens a website, a file, a folder, or a Windows Settings page (ms-settings: links). | no | the signed-in user |

### Advanced

| Type | What it does | Revertible | Runs as |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`registry.set`](actions/registry.set.md) | Writes a registry value. Use this for any Windows setting that has no dedicated action. | yes | depends on the fields (see below) |
| [`service.control`](actions/service.control.md) | Starts or stops a Windows service. | yes | SYSTEM (machine automations only) |
